name: Skeleton Key Mold
summary: The Skeleton Key Mold shapes a thorium-and-bone key stem in Fire Plume Ridge’s lava. Apothecary Dithers needs the unfinished key for the fight against the Scourge in Andorhal.

sections.title: A Mold for the Key
sections.body: Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan sells you the Skeleton Key Mold for work at Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater. With two Thorium Bars, its bearer can use the mold beside the lava lake to fuse thorium and bone into an unfinished key stem. Krinkle says the lava's heat will do the forging, but the thorium must be supplied separately.

faq.q: What is the Skeleton Key Mold for?
faq.answer: The Skeleton Key Mold shapes a thorium-and-bone key stem in the lava at Fire Plume Ridge.
Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan sells you the Skeleton Key Mold for the work at Fire Plume Ridge. Apothecary Dithers is sorry you had to bear its fee.

faq.q: What do I need with the mold?
faq.answer: Two Thorium Bars are needed with the Skeleton Key Mold to forge the unfinished key stem.
Use the Skeleton Key Mold beside the lava lake at the top of Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater.

faq.q: Why is Dithers making a skeleton key?
faq.answer: Dithers is preparing the key as part of the effort to strike at the Scourge in Andorhal.

angles.text: Dithers calls on you to help counter the Scourge, whose power holds Andorhal.
Thorium is needed to forge the key stem, though Krinkle Goodsteel leaves its acquisition to you.
